theater: 斯摩棱斯克土地與奧爾沙河谷

battle.name: 第四次莫斯科-立陶宛戰爭
battle.theater: 斯摩棱斯克土地與奧爾沙河谷
battle.brief: 一五一二年內訌迫使立陶宛大公西吉斯蒙德一世重整軍權，聯軍於同年夏深入斯摩棱斯克土地，九月八日在奧爾沙擊潰莫斯科野戰主力，一五一三年秋再圍斯摩棱斯克，至一五一四年二月城池陷落，第四次莫斯科-立陶宛戰爭以此收場。全軍火力仍以火繩步槍為主，日耳曼傭兵輕騎與大公近衛卻已開始試用輪發手槍，此槍無須點火繩，雨雪天候亦可射擊，是歐洲騎兵首次在馬上擁有與步槍手相當的反擊能力。

kit.name: 輪發手槍
kit.history: 最早的後膛手槍。機械太貴，只給火槍隊的軍官與近衛。

countries: 這場衝突的交戰方是兩個正在成形中的國家機器：立陶宛大公國與莫斯科大公國。立陶宛一側以波蘭國王兼大公西吉斯蒙德一世為最高統帥，但真正握著軍隊的是大公直屬的立陶宛騎士軍團、日耳曼與匈牙利傭兵騎兵隊、克里米亞汗國借出的韃靼輕騎，以及波羅的海沿岸徵召的德意志長槍手與火槍手；在大公制式的編制上，立陶宛人習慣把全軍分成前鋒、中軍與後衛三段，由大軍統帥居中率領，作為衝鋒的骨幹。聯邦內部此刻正撕裂成兩派：以瓦西里·拉茲維爾、揚·薩皮耶哈、康斯坦丁·奧斯特羅格斯基等樞密為代表的封建派，主張先鞏固本邦莊園與自治權；以大公與王室顧問米哈伊爾·格林斯基為代表的王室派，則要靠對外戰爭收回一四九○年代之後失去的領土。一五一二年二月維爾納議會上，兩派在得知樞密院曾單獨與莫斯科議和之後公開翻臉；大公同年春天在維爾納舉行效忠儀式，把樞密與各支軍官重新綁在自己一方，才算重新把兵權握在手中。莫斯科方面則是靠服役土地制與屯田制供養的世襲軍，兵源以莫斯科及周邊各縣的役夫騎兵為主，由出身波亞爾家族的主帥統率；其政教結構以羅斯正教會為國教，西部教區與立陶宛正教會的隸屬糾紛一直未決，同時還要分兵應付克里米亞、喀山與諾蓋方向的邊境壓力，兵員調度極為緊張。
countriesEn: The belligerents were two state machines in the process of taking shape: the Grand Duchy of Lithuania and the Tsardom of Moscow. On the Lithuanian side the supreme commander was Sigismund I the Old, King of Poland and Grand Duke of Lithuania, but the troops themselves were the Grand Duke's own Lithuanian mounted retinue, German and Hungarian mercenary horse companies, Tatar light cavalry lent by the Crimean Khanate, and German pikemen and handgunners recruited from the Baltic littoral; in the grand captain's order of battle the army was habitually divided into vanguard, main body and rearguard, with the Lithuanian regiment under the grand hetman forming the striking core of the centre. The federation was at that moment torn in two: the feudal party of the magnate council, led by Vasily Radziwiłł, Jan Sapieha and Konstanty Ostrogski, argued for consolidating their own estates and privileges at home, while the royal party of the Grand Duke and his councillor Michał Gliński wanted to recover the territories lost since the 1490s through an external war. When it emerged at the Diet of Vilnius in February 1512 that the council had already concluded a separate peace with Moscow, the two parties openly broke; in the spring of the same year the Grand Duke bound the magnates back to himself with a ceremony of homage at Vilnius, and only then truly had the army in his hands. Muscovy fielded a hereditary army maintained by the service land system and by settlements, drawn mainly from the service cavalry of Moscow and the surrounding districts, and commanded by hetmans drawn from the boyar families; its political and religious structure was built on the Russian Orthodox Church, the question of the western dioceses and of the reach of Orthodox jurisdiction remained unsettled, and the government was at the same time obliged to hold troops against Crimean, Kazan and Nogai pressure along the frontier, which made any redeployment of men extremely difficult.
people: 西吉斯蒙德一世在這場戰爭裡的角色最為矛盾：他既是名正言順的立陶宛大公，卻有整整一年只是大公國的傀儡，直到一五一二年議會風波之後才逐步收攏指揮權。真正在野外打出戰果的是立陶宛大軍統帥康斯坦丁·奧斯特羅格斯基，這位出身特羅克大公家系的將領在四十歲上下便率聯軍深入斯摩棱斯克土地，並在一五一二年九月八日的奧爾沙之役親自指揮突擊，把莫斯科方面的主帥逐個擒下；他早於一五○八年一度被解除大軍統帥職，一五一二年重新出山，正是立陶宛反攻能夠成事的人事關鍵。樞密一派中最强硬的是瓦西里·拉茲維爾，他與大公在議會上正面衝突，最終在效忠儀式之後交出兵權；揚·薩皮耶哈更不肯罷休，一五一五年維爾納城下的內戰中，王室軍隊擊潰了他率領的叛軍。莫斯科方面的核心人物是大公瓦西里三世，他在奧爾沙慘敗之後迅速重整軍隊，調集援軍封堵斯摩棱斯克，同時在北線擱住波蘭-立陶宛與利沃尼亞軍隊的北進；他最倚重的將領是切廖亞德寧、申尼亞與一批出身羅斯托夫、雅羅斯拉夫爾的波亞爾主帥，其中申尼亞在奧爾沙被俘，隨後被押往維爾納看管。戰場記錄主要來自莫斯科編年史家索方尼（索福尼·梁贊）的編年與立陶宛方面的同期記載，以及後來波蘭編年史家馬爾丁·別爾斯基的追述；幾種說法對雙方兵力的估計彼此矛盾，讀時須加以分辨。
peopleEn: Sigismund I's part in this war was the most contradictory of all: he was the lawful Grand Duke of Lithuania, yet for the best part of a year he was only a puppet of the duchy, and it took the storm in the diet of 1512 before he could gather the command into his own hands. The man who actually won his battles in the field was the Lithuanian grand hetman Konstanty Ostrogski, who, in his early forties, led the allied army deep into the Smolensk land and personally directed the assault at Orsha on 8 September 1512, taking the Muscovite commanders one by one; he had been relieved of the grand hetman's command as far back as 1508, and his return in 1512 was precisely the personnel key that made the Lithuanian counter-offensive possible. The hardest man of the magnate party was Vasily Radziwiłł, who confronted the Grand Duke openly in the diet and eventually gave up his troops after the ceremony of homage; Jan Sapieha was less willing to submit, and in the civil war fought outside Vilnius in 1515 the royal army broke the rebel host he led. The central figure on the Muscovite side was Grand Prince Vasili III, who after the disaster at Orsha quickly reformed his army, gathered reinforcements to seal Smolensk, and at the same time held off the northern thrust of the Polish-Lithuanian and Livonian forces; his most trusted commanders were Chelyadnin, Shchenya and a group of boyar hetmans from Rostov and Yaroslavl, of whom Shchenya was taken prisoner at Orsha and afterwards sent under guard to Vilnius. The record of the fighting comes chiefly from the chronicle of the Muscovite historian Sophony of Ryazan, from contemporary Lithuanian accounts, and from the later retrospection of the Polish chronicler Marcin Bielski; the several versions contradict each other on the size of the armies, and the reader has to separate them.
kits: 這場戰爭的兵器核心仍然是火繩火器，但在一五一二年的歐洲，作為軍官與輕騎佩槍的最前一代後膛槍，輪發手槍已經出現在聯軍序列裡。輪發手槍的機括出自南德意志一五○○年前後的鐘錶匠作坊：以主發條拉緊的發條筒帶動棘輪，扣下扳機時由棘輪推動火鎚輪猛擊底火盤的燧石起火，全槍無須火繩，因此雨天、嚴冬與騎乘當中都能使用；缺點是每槍要單獨配發底火藥瓶、主火藥紙包與一隻子彈模，一次裝填耗時甚多，實戰中每分鐘難得一發，槍身連同附件重近一公斤半，價錢只有富有的軍官與專職近衛騎兵用得起。在一五一二年的立陶宛聯軍中，實際攜帶輪發手槍的是日耳曼與匈牙利傭兵騎兵隊以及大公近衛；立陶宛本土騎士則仍以長矛、馬刀與短身手槍為主。兩軍的骨幹重火槍是俄式長身火槍「皮沙利」，槍身可達一公尺半以上，須架在支架上瞄準射擊，莫斯科軍另有更長更重的「索維爾納亞」式火槍，配以可拆分的槍托。近戰武器是維爾納式長矛、翼形長矛與波羅的彎刀，莫斯科與立陶宛兩軍都大量配備克里米亞式的複合弓與箭袋，弓騎在克里米亞與部分立陶宛輕騎手中一直是近戰主力。攻城方面，立陶宛方面有從奧格斯堡與維爾納鑄造廠出的小型攻城砲與隼砲野戰砲，斯摩棱斯克城頭則有俄國自鑄的守城重砲與火盆。冬季行軍依靠雪橇與牛車，渡過第聶伯河則靠皮筏與臨時浮橋。
kitsEn: The core of the arms of this war was still the matchlock firearm, but by 1512 in Europe the wheel-lock pistol, the first generation of rear-loading handguns carried by officers and light horse, had already appeared on the allied order of battle. The wheel-lock mechanism came out of the clockmakers' workshops of southern Germany around 1500: a mainspring barrel drives a ratchet, and when the trigger is pulled the ratchet turns a hammer wheel that strikes sparks from the frizzen into the priming pan, so that the piece needs no burning match and can be used in rain, in hard frost and on horseback. Its drawbacks are that each gun needs its own flask of priming powder, its paper cartridge of main charge and a separate bullet mould, so that loading takes a long time, a rate of no more than one round a minute is achievable in practice, and the gun with its fittings weighs close to a kilogram and a half, a price only wealthy officers and dedicated guards could afford. In the Lithuanian allied army of 1512 it was the German and Hungarian mercenary horse and the Grand Duke's own guard who actually carried wheel-lock pistols; the native Lithuanian knights still relied on lance, sabre and light handgun. The heavy firearm backbone of both armies was the Russian long musket known as the pishchal, with a barrel of over a metre and a half that had to be rested on a forked support to be aimed; the Muscovites also had the longer and heavier sovelnaya pattern, carried in sections. Melee weapons were the Vilnius lance, the winged lance and the Baltic sabre, while both Moscow and Lithuania equipped large numbers of Crimean composite bows and quivers, the bow remaining the close-combat arm of the Crimean and some Lithuanian light horse. For siege work the Lithuanian side had small siege guns and falcon field pieces from the foundries of Augsburg and Vilnius, while the walls of Smolensk carried Russian-cast heavy guns and fire basins. Winter movement depended on sledges and ox carts, and the Dnieper was crossed on rafts and improvised pontoon bridges.
tactics: 立陶宛聯軍在奧爾沙的戰法，是當時東歐草原騎兵與西歐火槍體系混合的典型產物。全軍先以克里米亞輕騎在前衛兩翼游弋，試探莫斯科騎兵縱隊的厚度；日耳曼與匈牙利傭兵騎兵在側翼不斷以手槍與火槍貼近射擊，逼迫對方騎兵掉頭回應，把縱隊拉成散亂的橫列；待莫斯科軍主力前傾、陣線一亂，立陶宛騎士團便以密集長矛縱隊自缺口楔入，再用翼形長矛的衝撞把中軍犁開，兩翼的德意志長槍手與火槍手以整排齊射封住缺口。莫斯科軍最擅長的是所謂的奇襲一擊：把大批矛兵與火槍騎兵集中於中央，以整隊衝鋒一次定勝負；一五一二年這種打法被立陶宛的佯退引誘而落空，前鋒衝過頭之後遭到兩翼包抄，縱隊被切斷，數千兵馬在奧爾沙河與克雷皮夫納河之間的河谷地帶互相踐踏。圍城則用標準的野戰圍城術：先以輕炮與火槍隊切斷城郊道路，再築土木圍城線與壕溝，工兵在牆根掘地道、爆破牆基，同時封鎖城內糧食，最終在守軍斷糧四個月後迫使其投降；守軍則靠城門突擊與冬季巡邏拖住攻方，卻始終等不到援兵。
tacticsEn: The way the Lithuanian allies fought at Orsha was a typical product of the meeting between the steppe cavalry of eastern Europe and the firearms system of the west. The army began with Crimean light horse working the wings of the vanguard to sound the depth of the Muscovite cavalry columns, while German and Hungarian mercenary horse pressed close on the flanks firing pistols and handguns to force the enemy horse to turn and answer them, drawing the column out into a disordered line; once the Muscovite main body leaned forward and the formation loosened, the Lithuanian mounted retinue wedged in with close ranks of lances and then ploughed the centre apart with the shock of the winged lance, the German pikemen and handgunners on both wings sealing the breach with simultaneous volleys. What the Muscovites did best was the so-called sudden strike: massing pikes and musketeer horse in the centre and committing everything to a single set-piece charge that would decide the day. In 1512 that device was baulked by a feigned retreat, the leading troops overshot, were enveloped on both flanks and cut off from the rest, and several thousand horsemen and men trampled one another in the valley between the Orsha and the Krapiuna rivers. The siege that followed was worked as a standard field siege: light guns and handgunners first cut the roads behind the town, then a timber-lined circumvallation and trench were dug, sappers undermined the base of the wall and blew it open, while the grain inside the town was sealed off, and in the end the defenders were starved out after four months and compelled to surrender; the garrison answered with sallies from the gates and winter patrols that kept the besiegers at bay, but relief never came.
data: 有根據的數字並不難找，但彼此矛盾。索方尼的編年記載一五一二年的莫斯科軍約三萬人，立陶宛聯軍約一萬人，莫斯科方面陣亡約五千人；波蘭與立陶宛方面的記錄則把立陶宛軍隊寫得更少，說只有八千至九千人，另一種說法強調聯軍是靠韃靼與德意志傭兵的兩翼奇襲取勝；無論採用哪一組數字，比例大致是三比一至二比一。奧爾沙之役的日期是九月八日，莫斯科方面被俘的主帥有數人，包括申尼亞與切廖亞德寧。斯摩棱斯克之圍自一五一三年秋起延至次年二月，歷時約四個月，圍城軍在兩萬上下，被圍的守軍只有數千人。同一時期，瓦西里三世在北線擱住了波蘭-立陶宛與利沃尼亞軍隊對普斯科夫的三面圍城，該役自一五一三年九月打到十一月，十一月間利沃尼亞騎士團先行退出，普斯科夫守到援軍趕到為止。戰爭本身沒有留下可靠的總傷亡數字；可以確認的是斯摩棱斯克在二月二十三日陷落，莫斯科方面在同年收復了斯摩棱斯克以北的若干小城，但斯摩棱斯克本身始終留在立陶宛手中。
dataEn: Grounded figures are not hard to find, though they contradict one another. The chronicle of Sophony gives about thirty thousand Muscovites against some ten thousand Lithuanians in 1512, with roughly five thousand of the Muscovite force killed; the Polish and Lithuanian accounts write the Lithuanian army down still smaller, at eight or nine thousand, while another version stresses that the allies won by an enveloping stroke delivered by the Tatars and the German mercenaries. Whichever set of numbers is taken, the ratio is somewhere between three to one and two to one. The date of the battle of Orsha is 8 September, and several Muscovite commanders were taken prisoner, among them Shchenya and Chelyadnin. The siege of Smolensk ran from the autumn of 1513 to February of the following year, roughly four months, with the besieging force on the order of twenty thousand against a few thousand defenders. At the same time Vasili III held off at the northern front the three-sided siege of Pskov by Polish-Lithuanian and Livonian troops, which ran from September to November 1513; in November the Livonian knights withdrew first, and Pskov held out until relief arrived. No reliable total casualty figure survives for the war itself; what is certain is that Smolensk fell on 23 February, that Moscow recovered several small towns north of Smolensk in the same year, and that Smolensk itself remained in Lithuanian hands.
cause: 這場戰爭的直接起因是立陶宛內部的權力鬥爭，莫斯科只是利用了它。一四八七至一五○三年那場戰爭以一五○三年的和約收場：斯摩棱斯克歸立陶宛，其餘爭議地帶按當時的實際控制線瓜分，停戰的有效期只到一五○年代末。一五○八年莫斯科重新奪回斯摩棱斯克，切斷了立陶宛通往南方內陸的商道與糧道，這筆帳必須討回。就在這個節骨眼上，立陶宛樞密院的一派私下與莫斯科接洽，以承認既成事實換取莫斯科的諒解，等於在外交上先一步架空了大公。西吉斯蒙德得知之後在維爾納召開議會、拘押拉德齊維爾與薩皮耶哈，並以效忠儀式把樞密重新綁在自己一方；樞密為了保住手中的兵與莊園，也就必須讓立陶宛的軍隊打一場漂亮的仗來證明忠誠，於是戰爭在內政邏輯上被重新點燃，而莫斯科則趁立陶宛遠征、北方受壓之際，收回一五一二年前後失去的城邑。宗教上，西部教區的爭端與正教會勢力範圍的劃分為雙方提供了可以援引的口實；真正決定節奏的，還是克里米亞、喀山與諾蓋方向的邊境壓力，讓莫斯科無法把全部兵力集中到西線。
causeEn: The immediate cause of this war was a struggle for power inside Lithuania, and Moscow merely took advantage of it. The war of 1487 to 1503 ended with the peace of 1503: Smolensk went to Lithuania, the remaining disputed lands were divided along the lines of actual control, and the truce was to run only to the end of the 1500s. In 1508 Moscow retook Smolensk, cutting the trade route and the grain road that carried Lithuania's commerce into the southern interior, and that debt had to be collected. Precisely at that moment one party of the Lithuanian council negotiated privately with Moscow, offering recognition of the fait accompli in exchange for Moscow's understanding, which in diplomatic terms hollowed out the Grand Duke's authority before he could act. On learning of it Sigismund summoned the diet at Vilnius, arrested Radziwiłł and Sapieha, and bound the magnates back to himself with a ceremony of homage; and because the magnates needed to keep their troops and their estates, they in turn had to let the army win a striking victory to prove their loyalty. The war was thus relit from within, while Moscow, its enemy having marched away and its northern front under pressure, took back the towns lost around 1512. Religiously, the quarrel over the western dioceses and the reach of Orthodox jurisdiction gave both sides a usable pretext. What really set the pace, however, was the frontier pressure from the Crimea, Kazan and the Nogai, which kept Moscow from concentrating all its strength on the western front.
impact: 這場戰爭的意義主要不在戰果，而在它把立陶宛的內部裂痕擺到了前台，也把莫斯科第一次推到可以攻進立陶宛腹地的位置。一五一二年的聯軍雖然沒有佔領莫斯科，但立陶宛騎兵在奧爾沙把莫斯科的野戰主力正面擊潰，這在莫斯科的編年裡被記為一場國難；此後數十年莫斯科都要用重新編制軍隊來償還這一戰的債——加重服役田與屯田的供應、擴充重騎與火槍的比例、在克里米亞方向長期屯兵，都是這次失敗的直接後果。另一面，戰爭加劇了大公與樞密之間的矛盾，一五一五年維爾納的內戰標誌著王權最終壓過封建派，立陶宛的中央集權自此成形，這正是日後聯邦在法國、匈牙利與莫斯科三面受敵時仍能撐住的原因。斯摩棱斯克留在立陶宛手中又維持了近一百年，直到一六一一年波蘭王國趁俄國動亂再度奪回，一六五四年安德魯索沃休戰後歸屬俄國，一七七二年第一次瓜分波蘭時正式成為俄羅領土，這條土地糾紛的尾巴一直拖到近代。武器技術上，這場戰爭也標誌著火繩槍時代的頂點：槍手仍靠火繩點火，雨雪天候下效率大跌，而輪發手槍這類新式後膛武器雖則笨貴昂貴，卻已可在任何天候使用，並讓騎兵第一次在馬上擁有與步槍手相當的反擊能力，這條技術路線最終通向十六世紀末的輕騎手槍化。
impactEn: The significance of this war lies less in its results than in the fact that it laid the internal fissures of Lithuania bare and carried Moscow for the first time to a position from which the Lithuanian interior could be raided. The allied army of 1512 did not take Moscow, but the Lithuanian horse destroyed the Muscovite field army outright at Orsha, and the Muscovite chronicle records it as a national disaster; for decades afterwards Moscow repaid the debt of that battle by reorganising its army, by loading more onto the service lands and the settlements, by raising the share of heavy cavalry and firearms, and by keeping troops permanently in the Crimean direction. On the other side the war sharpened the quarrel between the Grand Duke and the council, and the civil war outside Vilnius in 1515 marked the final victory of royal authority over the feudal party; the centralisation of Lithuania took shape here, and that is why the federation could later hold out when pressed from France, Hungary and Moscow at once. Smolensk stayed in Lithuanian hands for close to a century, until the Kingdom of Poland seized it again in 1611 during the Russian interregnum; it passed to Russia by the truce of Andrusovo in 1654 and became formally Russian territory in the first partition of Poland in 1772, and the tail of that land dispute dragged on into modern times. On the technical side the war also marks the high point of the matchlock era: the musketeer still needed a burning match, and his rate of fire collapsed in rain and snow, while the new rear-loading weapons such as the wheel-lock pistol, heavy and expensive though they were, could be used in any weather and gave mounted men for the first time a reply on horseback comparable to that of the foot musketeer, a line of development that ended in the pistol-armed light cavalry of the late sixteenth century.
result: 一五一四年二月二十三日，被圍四個月的斯摩棱斯克向立陶宛聯軍投降；守軍在缺糧、援軍不至與城外攻勢不停三重壓力之下屈服，這座九世紀以來反覆易手的要塞回到立陶宛手中，第四次莫斯科-立陶宛戰爭至此實質結束。莫斯科雖然在同年內收復了斯摩棱斯克以北的若干小城，核心要地卻仍未奪回；雙方隨後並未簽訂正式和約，前線大體維持在斯摩棱斯克河流域的舊界線上，直到一五二二年利沃尼亞戰爭的停戰才把整條邊界一次劃清。戰爭的直接結果是：立陶宛在斯摩棱斯克土地取得短期戰略優勢，大公的權威也藉一場勝利重新蓋過樞密；莫斯科則在慘敗中學會了以奇襲一擊之外的方式重建軍隊，並把注意力轉向喀山與克里米亞，而不是立刻再打。第三次戰爭遺下的失地問題被推遲而未解決，第四次戰爭拿回來的斯摩棱斯克在一六一一年再度易手，說明這一輪拉鋸遠未結束。武器與戰術層面上，聯軍靠混合騎兵——立陶宛重騎、日耳曼手槍輕騎、克里米亞弓騎——的協同取勝，莫斯科密集而呆板的火槍縱隊則暴露了正面衝鋒的脆弱，兩者都成為此後數十年東歐戰場的基本樣板。
resultEn: On 23 February 1514 Smolensk, besieged for four months, capitulated to the Lithuanian allies. The garrison yielded under the triple pressure of hunger, of relief that never came and of unremitted pressure from outside the walls, and this fortress, which had changed hands repeatedly since the ninth century, returned to Lithuania; there the fourth Moscow-Lithuanian war came effectively to an end. Moscow recovered several small towns north of Smolensk within the same year but did not regain the prize itself; no formal peace treaty was concluded, and the front remained broadly on the old line along the Smolensk river until the armistice of the Livonian War in 1522 drew the whole frontier in a single stroke. The immediate results were these: Lithuania won a short-term strategic advantage on the Smolensk land, and the Grand Duke's authority once more overbore the council; Moscow, taught by its defeat, rebuilt its army by means other than the single sudden strike and turned its attention towards Kazan and the Crimea instead of fighting again at once. The territorial question left over from the third war was postponed rather than settled, and the Smolensk recovered in the fourth war changed hands again in 1611, which shows how far from over this round of struggle still was. At the level of weapons and tactics, the allies won through the cooperation of mixed cavalry — Lithuanian heavy horse, German pistol-armed light horse, Crimean horse archers — while the Muscovite dense and rigid columns of firearms exposed the fragility of the frontal charge, and both became the basic pattern of the eastern European battlefield for the decades that followed.
